answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Signed taxi medallion with transport authority attestation. It demands a medallion the transport authority issued, and the gale is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a medallion the transport authority issued takes calendar time as well as money — and the sparrow is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the ember is that the farm's unit economics never work.
